acceptanceCriteria: TestUPDV0004PartialArchiveCancellation passes 200 consecutive runs with go test -count=200 -run TestUPDV0004PartialArchiveCancellation ./internal/update, including under a concurrent full-package run.
The test still proves a partially read archive body is closed and the apply is refused on cancellation, without depending on a wall-clock deadline elapsing after the archive request starts.
body: Observed 2026-10-10 while working V1-0639. TestUPDV0004PartialArchiveCancellation (internal/update/update_test.go:509) fails intermittently with `archive body not partially read and closed: <nil>`: 4 of 40 runs at origin/main 64b5d174 and 3 of 40 on the V1-0639 branch (darwin/arm64, go1.27.1). Cause (inferred from the nil body): the test bounds apply with context.WithTimeout(500ms), and under load the installed-version probe plus release discovery consume that budget before the /archive request is made, so the interrupted body is never created. Expected: the test cancels only after the archive body has been partially read (e.g. cancel from interruptedBody.Read after the first chunk) so the assertion does not race the deadline. Actual: a timing-dependent failure that can fail CI for unrelated update changes.
title: TestUPDV0004PartialArchiveCancellation is flaky: 500ms deadline can expire before the archive request
